Name: Greenhouse Message
Author: Geminia
Description:
You can use this mod to alter the message displayed by a greenhouse that is not yet accessible to the farmer (or farmhands).  Once the greenhouse has been purchased through Joja or its bundles have been completed via the Community Center, the message will no longer be displayed. 

You can easily change the message displayed.  See the "README.TXT" in the downloaded and unzipped file.

Downloads.Description: Replaces the message received when trying to open a ruined Greenhouse.
